title: Personal Checking: Age, Military and Employee Waivers and the Paper Statement Fee
content:
This quick reference collects the Personal Checking maintenance fee waivers that rest on facts in the customer profile rather than on account activity, together with the per-cycle charge for paper statements.

## Definitions

- **Younger-owner waiver** — no maintenance fee while the primary owner is still under the figure shown on the day the cycle closes.
- **Older-owner waiver** — no maintenance fee once the primary owner has reached the figure shown, judged on the day the cycle closes.
- **Military waiver** — "yes" means that a profile showing the owner on active military duty removes the maintenance fee.
- **Employee waiver** — "yes" means that a profile showing the owner as a current PCB employee removes the maintenance fee.
- **Paper statement fee (USD)** — charged per statement cycle when statements are delivered on paper at cycle close.
- **Paper fee exemption age** — primary owners at least this old at cycle close pay no paper statement fee.

## By tier

| Tier | Younger-owner waiver (under) | Older-owner waiver (at least) | Military | Employee | Paper statement fee | Paper fee exemption age |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 25 | 65 | yes | yes | 0.00 | 65 |
| Student Checking | not offered | not offered | no | no | 0.00 | 65 |
| Everyday Checking | 25 | 65 | yes | yes | 2.00 | 65 |
| Interest Checking | not offered | 65 | yes | yes | 2.00 | 65 |
| Premier Checking | not offered | not offered | yes | yes | 0.00 | 65 |
| Private Client Checking | not offered | not offered | no | yes | 0.00 | 65 |

## Basis Q&A

**Does a 25-year-old owner of Everyday Checking get the younger-owner waiver?** No. That waiver applies only below 25; at exactly 25 the owner is no longer under the figure.

**Does a 65-year-old owner of Interest Checking get the older-owner waiver?** Yes. The comparison is "at least", so reaching 65 by cycle close is enough.

**Which tiers charge for paper statements at all?** Only Everyday Checking and Interest Checking, at 2.00 USD per cycle; the other tiers show 0.00.
